description: This Java class AssetUtils provides utility methods for loading assets such as raw byte data, JSON objects, and Bitmaps from the app's assets directory in an Android application. It includes methods to load and parse JSON files and handle InputStreams with proper exception handling.

classes.name: AssetUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to load assets such as byte arrays, JSON objects, and Bitmaps from the app's assets folder for use in an Android application.

methods.name: loadAsset
methods.description: Loads a raw asset as a byte array given the asset filename.

methods.name: loadJSONAsset
methods.description: Loads a JSON asset and parses it into a JSONObject.

methods.name: loadBitmapAsset
methods.description: Loads an image asset and decodes it into a Bitmap object.
